Set up the monorepo, run tests, build the library, and update the docs.

## Prerequisites

- **Node.js 24** — the workspace `engines` field requires exactly v24
- **pnpm 11.3.0** — declared as `packageManager` in the root `package.json`

## Clone and Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/claudio-darkkenergy/plexis.git
cd plexis
pnpm install
```

`pnpm install` runs from the repository root and installs all workspace packages (`@tde.io/plexis` and `@tde.io/docs`) from a single lockfile.

## Repository Layout

```
plexis/
  packages/
    plexis/          ← @tde.io/plexis — published library
  apps/
    docs/            ← @tde.io/docs — this Astro Starlight site
  .github/
    workflows/       ← build.yml, test.yml, publish.yml, docs.yml
```

## Running Tests

From the repository root:

```bash
pnpm test
```

This delegates to `@tde.io/plexis` and runs all tests via Vitest. Tests live in `packages/plexis/tests/`.

## Building the Library

From the repository root:

```bash
pnpm build
```

Produces three output formats under `packages/plexis/dist/`:
- `dist/esm/` — ES modules
- `dist/cjs/` — CommonJS
- `dist/types/` — TypeScript declaration files

## Typechecking

```bash
pnpm typecheck
```

Runs `tsc --noEmit` scoped to `@tde.io/plexis`.

## Running Examples

From `packages/plexis/`:

```bash
pnpm run example:order
pnpm run example:payment
pnpm run example:graph
```

## Updating the Docs

Start the local dev server from the repository root:

```bash
pnpm docs
```

This starts the Astro dev server for `apps/docs/` at `http://localhost:4321`. Edit MDX files under `apps/docs/src/content/docs/` — the dev server live-reloads on every save.

Build the docs site to verify there are no errors:

```bash
pnpm docs:build
```

This produces a static site under `apps/docs/dist/`. The docs build is independent of the library build — `pnpm docs:build` does not require `pnpm build` to have run first (no docs module imports the library yet).

## Version Model

The docs site documents the **latest published release** of `@tde.io/plexis` — what users get when they run `npm install @tde.io/plexis`. The site's `@tde.io/plexis` devDependency uses `workspace:*`, which resolves to the in-repo package. Because the docs currently contain no code that imports the library at build time, this is equivalent to documenting the published version. Update the docs pages in the same PR as any API change so they stay in sync.

If you add a doc page that actually imports from `@tde.io/plexis` at build time (e.g., the deferred interactive playground), `pnpm docs:build` will then require the library to be built first (`pnpm build`). Until that happens, the docs build is independent.

## Vercel Preview Deployments

When you push a branch, the Vercel GitHub integration automatically creates a preview deployment and posts a URL to the commit status. This lets reviewers see docs changes live before merging.

Production deploys happen automatically when a commit lands on `main`.

If the Vercel build fails but `pnpm docs:build` passes locally, check the Vercel build logs. The most common cause is a workspace dependency resolution issue — verify that the Vercel project settings have **Root Directory** set to `apps/docs` and that pnpm workspace detection is enabled. Vercel handles this automatically for monorepos that have a root `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

## CI Workflows

| Workflow | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `build.yml` | Push to any branch, tag `v*.*.*` | Typechecks and builds the library |
| `test.yml` | After `build.yml` succeeds | Runs the Vitest test suite |
| `publish.yml` | Tag `v*.*.*` | Publishes `@tde.io/plexis` to npm with OIDC provenance |
| `docs.yml` | Push to any branch | Builds the Astro docs site to catch MDX errors |

The `docs.yml` workflow is independent — it does not gate library CI and library CI does not gate it.

## Releasing a New Version

1. Bump the version in `packages/plexis/package.json`:

   ```bash
   cd packages/plexis && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
   ```

2. Commit and push to `main`.

3. Push a matching tag to trigger Publish:

   ```bash
   git tag v1.2.3 && git push origin v1.2.3
   ```

The Publish workflow authenticates via GitHub OIDC — no `NPM_TOKEN` secret is needed.

## Definition Functions

### `defineDomain(id, setup, options?)`

Creates and returns a `Domain` instance. The setup function runs synchronously; `state()` registrations are collected and used to build the domain.

```typescript
function defineDomain<TContext, TEdges>(
  id: string,
  setup: () => DomainSetupResult<TContext>,
  options?: DefineDomainOptions<TContext>
): Domain<TContext, TEdges>
```

`DomainSetupResult`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `TContext` | Initial context |
| `initial` | string | Initial state ID |
| `strict` | `boolean` | Throw on unknown events instead of returning `'ignored'` |
| `errorPolicy` | `ErrorPolicy` | Default error policy for handlers |

`DefineDomainOptions`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tracer` | `Tracer` | Tracer instance to attach |
| `merge` | function | Custom context merge function `(prev, patch, metadata) => TContext` |

---

### `definePipeline(id, setup, options?)`

Creates and returns a `Pipeline` instance. The setup function runs synchronously; `node()` registrations are collected.

```typescript
function definePipeline<TContext>(
  id: string,
  setup: () => PipelineSetupResult,
  options?: DefinePipelineOptions<TContext>
): Pipeline<TContext>
```

`PipelineSetupResult`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `initial` | string | ID of the first node to execute |

`DefinePipelineOptions`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tracer` | `Tracer` | Tracer instance to attach |
| `errorPolicy` | `ErrorPolicy` | Default error policy for node actions |
| `merge` | function | Custom context merge function `(prev, patch, metadata) => TContext` |

## Registration Helpers

These functions are only valid inside an active `defineDomain` or `definePipeline` setup function. Calling them outside throws `PlexisError` with code `BUILDER_CLOSED`.

### `state(id, def)`

Registers a state in the current domain builder scope.

```typescript
function state<TContext>(id: string, def: StateNodeDef<TContext>): void
```

`StateNodeDef` fields:

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `edges` | `Record<string, EdgeDef>` |
| `onEnter` | `(ctx, input: StateHookInput) => patch` |
| `onExit` | `(ctx, input: StateHookInput) => patch` |
| `pipeline` | `Pipeline` |
| `terminal` | `boolean` |

---

### `edge(def)`

Creates an `EdgeDef` for use in a state's `edges` map.

```typescript
function edge<TContext>(def: EdgeDef<TContext>): EdgeDef<TContext>
```

`EdgeDef` fields:

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `target` | string |
| `guard` | `(ctx, input: GuardInput) => boolean` |
| `action` | `(ctx, input: TransitionActionInput) => patch` |
| `pipeline` | `Pipeline` |

---

### `node(id, def)`

Registers a node in the current pipeline builder scope.

```typescript
function node<TContext>(id: string, def: PipelineNodeDef<TContext>): void
```

`PipelineNodeDef` fields:

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `action` | `(ctx, input: PipelineActionInput) => patch` |
| `forks` | array of `PipelineForkDef` |
| `terminal` | `boolean` |

---

### `fork(condition, target, options?)`

Creates a `PipelineForkDef` for use in a node's `forks` array.

```typescript
function fork<TContext>(
  condition: ((ctx, input) => boolean | Promise<boolean>) | undefined,
  target: string | Pipeline<TContext>,
  options?: { label?: string; metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }
): PipelineForkDef<TContext>
```

Pass `undefined` as the condition for an unconditional forward edge.

---

### `terminal(def?)`

Creates a `PipelineNodeDef` with `terminal: true`. Optionally accepts a partial node definition (excluding `terminal`).

```typescript
function terminal<TContext>(
  def?: Omit<PipelineNodeDef<TContext>, 'terminal'>
): PipelineNodeDef<TContext>
```
